description: Call this tool to write the whole library to one file and return the path, format and count. It is written in contract order, so it re-imports the same way. markdown is free; json is Pro.

format.description: json (a Pro feature) or markdown (works in the free tier)

overwrite.description: Replace the destination if a file is already there. Without it an existing file is never touched

path.description: Destination file path. The clauses are written in assembly order, categories first

name: clause_export
title: Export clauses
